highlights: Billing Pro Android style animated splash loading screen with UNIQON logo.
ESC key exit confirmation dialog with automatic closing safety backup.
Swiggy & Zomato toggle in Settings to keep billing screen clean and spacious.

Mouse Right-Click item quantity decrement (-1) and instant cart management.
Day-End Closing (Z-Report) date picker and historical sales calendar navigation.
